protocol.audits: all grid energies/selection/geometry invariants, pair/HA initial forces and native callback path, all final H geometry and exact heavy immobility, all failures retained
protocol.enrollment: ALL24 exact native H Systems/starts, two matched arms, no new H seeds
protocol.intervention: only generated THR24 HG21/HG22/HG23 rigidly rotate together around fixed CG2-to-CB axis; preserve all other initial coordinates, C-H lengths and internal geometry
protocol.invariants: all original forces/parameters/masses unchanged; no H regeneration, force ablation, integration or whole-system minimization; unchanged control must reproduce exact endpoint
protocol.limits: post-attribution mechanism control on one protein, not production selection, general rotamer search or repair qualification
protocol.selection: enumerate fixed 24-angle grid, choose minimum original whole-System initial potential energy; near-ties choose shortest rotation then signed angle; never score final/native accuracy
